name: Tidio
description: Manage Tidio (live chat, helpdesk and Lyro AI) contacts, contact conversations, tickets and ticket replies from any AI agent via the Tidio OpenAPI. 10 tools, Client ID + Client Secret (Tidio Plus or Premium).
instructions:
This connector wraps the Tidio OpenAPI, Tidio's REST API at `https://api.tidio.com` (docs: https://developers.tidio.com). Tidio has no GraphQL API.

**Plan**: the OpenAPI is available on the **Plus** and **Premium** plans only (Starter, Growth and paid Lyro plans reach just the product-recommendation endpoints, which this connector does not use). Free has no API access.

**Setup**:
1. In the Tidio panel open **Settings → Developer → OpenAPI** (https://www.tidio.com/panel/settings/developer). Only the project owner and admins see this section.
2. Click **Generate API Key**: Tidio shows a pair of keys once — copy both.
3. Paste the key starting with `ci_` into `TIDIO_CLIENT_ID` and the one starting with `cs_` into `TIDIO_CLIENT_SECRET`.

**Authentication**: every request carries `X-Tidio-Openapi-Client-Id` and `X-Tidio-Openapi-Client-Secret`, plus the mandatory version header `Accept: application/json; version=1`. The connector sends all three.

**Workflow**:
- Contacts: `tidio_list_contacts`, `tidio_get_contact_by_email`, `tidio_get_contact`, then `tidio_get_contact_messages` for the chat history with that contact, or `tidio_update_contact` to change name, email, phone or custom properties.
- Tickets (helpdesk): `tidio_list_tickets` → `tidio_get_ticket` (with messages) → `tidio_reply_to_ticket`. Replying as an operator needs an operator ID from `tidio_list_operators`.

**Live chats are read through the contact**: the OpenAPI has no endpoint to list conversations or to send a chat message as an operator; the chat history is `tidio_get_contact_messages`, and written replies go to tickets.

**Contact properties**: `tidio_update_contact` only accepts properties already defined in the Tidio panel (Settings → Contact properties); an unknown property or a wrong type is answered with a validation error. A field set to null is cleared; a field left out stays untouched.

**Pagination**: list tools answer with `meta.cursor`; pass it back as `cursor` for the next page. A null cursor means the last page.

**Rate limits** (per project): Plus 60 requests/minute, Premium 120/minute. A 429 answers `too_many_requests`; `x-ratelimit-remaining` shows what is left.

**Errors** come as `{ "errors": [{ "code", "message" }] }` — `not_found`, `not_valid`, `too_many_requests`, …

**Out of scope here**: Lyro data sources and products, webhooks, the Analytics API.

tools.name: tidio_get_project
tools.description: Return the Tidio project the keys belong to: its project ID and whether it is currently online or offline.

tools.name: tidio_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (identified website visitors) with their name, email, phone, language, country, consent and custom properties. Cursor-paginated: pass meta.cursor back as cursor.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's meta.cursor; omit for the first page.

tools.name: tidio_get_contact_by_email
tools.description: Find the contact(s) with an exact email address. Returns the same contact objects as tidio_list_contacts, so take the id from contacts[0].

tools.name: tidio_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact by ID with all its fields and custom properties.

contact_id.description: Contact ID (UUID), from tidio_list_contacts or tidio_get_contact_by_email.

tools.name: tidio_update_contact
tools.description: Update a contact's email, first/last name, phone or custom properties. Only the fields you pass change; null clears a field. Custom properties must already exist in the Tidio panel.

contact_id.description: Contact ID (UUID), from tidio_list_contacts or tidio_get_contact_by_email.

properties.description: Custom properties to set, as [{"name": "shoe_size", "value": "44"}]; a null value clears one.

tools.name: tidio_get_contact_messages
tools.description: Read the chat history with a contact: messages from the contact, operators and bots, plus a link to the conversation in the Tidio panel. Cursor-paginated: pass meta.cursor back as cursor.

contact_id.description: Contact ID (UUID), from tidio_list_contacts or tidio_get_contact_by_email.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's meta.cursor; omit for the first page.

tools.name: tidio_list_tickets
tools.description: List helpdesk tickets with subject, status (open, pending, solved), priority, contact and assignee, without messages. Cursor-paginated: pass meta.cursor back as cursor.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's meta.cursor; omit for the first page.

tools.name: tidio_get_ticket
tools.description: Get one helpdesk ticket with all its details and messages (public replies and internal notes).

tools.name: tidio_reply_to_ticket
tools.description: Add a reply to a helpdesk ticket, as an operator (needs operator_id) or as the contact. message_type internal makes it a note only operators see.

author_type.description: Who the reply is from: operator (default) or contact.

operator_id.description: Operator ID (UUID) from tidio_list_operators; needed when author_type is operator.

message_type.description: public (sent to the contact) or internal (a note for operators).

tools.name: tidio_list_operators
tools.description: List the project's operators (support agents) with their IDs, names and emails — the operator_id for tidio_reply_to_ticket. Cursor-paginated: pass meta.cursor back as cursor.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's meta.cursor; omit for the first page.
